dimensions.note: No credentials or configuration are accepted; credential-bearing evidence URLs are rejected.
Evaluate logs structured entry and completion messages without evidence content.
Strict parsing, chronology, identity, privacy, and output bounds fail before the sole write.
Tests cover deterministic grouping, thresholds, freshness/privacy, malformed identities, chronology, replay binding, output bounds, and persistence.
Request ID is bound to evaluation ID; equal replay inputs produce equal output and the same validated instance name.
No external API or network access exists.
No external handles, temporary files, or remote resources exist.
Published examples and fixtures contain only generic synthetic identifiers and example.test URLs.
All public and nested objects are strict; strings, arrays, inputs, groups, and evidence links are bounded.
The sole evaluation resource declares infinite lifetime and bounded GC retention.
This is a pure evaluator, not an external CRUD lifecycle model.
No external mutation or provider operation exists.
The sole write uses evaluation-<validated requestId>, bound to evaluationId.
Initial unpublished version; the registry reports no prior publication.
